definitions.explanation: The quality of food or drink as perceived by the palate. A more refined or literary term than simply {味|あじ}.
An intangible quality of depth, elegance, or appeal in things like art, scenery, experiences, or craftsmanship. Suggests something that becomes more appreciated the more one engages with it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{味|あじ}わい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This dish has a deep flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}わい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}わい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Handmade pottery has a unique charm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}わい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねる→年を重ねる：20549_toshiwokasaneru⟧ほど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味|あじ}わい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: This actor gains more depth with each passing year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{味|あじ}わい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}できる→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times you read this novel, you can discover new depth.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{味|あじ}わい (deep flavor/richness)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}わい (unique charm)
- {味|あじ}わい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (have character/depth)
- {味|あじ}わい{深|ぶか}い (full of depth, richly flavored)

The nominalized form of the verb ⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (to savor). More evocative and literary than the simple noun ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (taste). The figurative sense 2 is very common and suggests something that rewards careful, lingering appreciation.
